value.rationale: The first repetition at which arbitrary reference entanglement is destroyed is an operationally natural quantity for exactly the recently introduced exceptional channel. Its behavior is not inferable from the defective eigenvalue alone: the result classifies finite versus infinite lifetimes, computes all finite-iteration thresholds, extracts a universal weak-noise crossover on both sides of the exceptional point, and exactly characterizes a countably infinite family of resonant optimum drive/noise ratios within the physically fixed-axis control class. This is more than a fixed-parameter substitution or numeric cutoff.
